text:
Meenal: Hey @runtime-team, @infra, @security — need triage and reviews on PR touching KV cache eviction ordering + authz header sequencing. Blocking a perf rollback. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/46291

Meenal: Short summary: fixes rare eviction race that increases tail latency under bursty short-sequence workloads. Adds explicit authz header ordering to avoid header reordering in egress path. No external API changes.

Alex M: I can take runtime review. Will look first thing tomorrow morning (ETA 10:30 PT).

Lisa: Security can review, but please add a brief threat model note and call out any KMS key usage. Also add a changelog entry. :lock:

Jorge: Infra fyi — we won't block, but please run the staging perf job before merge: `./scripts/run_staging.sh --profile=kv-eviction`

Sam K: I'll own the merge (if all green) and schedule into the 11:00-11:30 PT merge window. :calendar:

ci-bot: Build #982 failed on flaky test `cache_recovery_test`. Rerun requested by Meenal.

Meenal: Reran tests and added a unit test for ordering. Updated PR description with rollback plan and monitoring dashboard link: https://internal.redwood/monitoring/kv-eviction

Alex M: Quick nit in allocator.cpp — prefer `std::optional<size_t>` over sentinel -1. Patch suggested:
```
- int64_t evict_idx = -1;
+ std::optional<size_t> evict_idx;
```
Otherwise runtime LGTM.

Lisa: Security question — does this change headers sent to external services? If yes, need unit tests and docs.

Meenal: No external calls changed, only internal header ordering. Added unit test and commit note.

Jorge: Staging perf looks fine — p95 latency unchanged, throughput steady. :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: Rerun Build #983 passed — 2245 tests, 2 flaky skipped.

Sam K: All clear. I'll merge at 11:10 PT (within window). If anything fails, I will rollback to release tag v1.18.2.

Lisa: Approved. :lock: :thumbsup:

Alex M: +1 from runtime. Thanks all.

Meenal: Thanks team — leaving the merge to Sam. Will follow up on post-deploy perf checks.
